title: [Keyboard Manager] Per-keyboard remap profiles (auto-switch + cycle hotkey)

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The 18 older-revision proposals are withdrawn. Current initialization tracing supports a possible first-use default-profile switching defect, but source reachability is not behavioral proof. Existing UI tests precreate the default file and manipulate session settings/input; unit tests disable native initialization, so neither is a safe full-route reproducer. Required next prerequisite is a disposable isolated Windows guest with guest-local automation, followed by an authorized build and interaction-validation slot. No current-revision candidate validation or review convergence is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
